scope: New one-axis, no-drag total axial pressing-force development study; not qualification of the long-term surface-normal sanding requirement.
force_metric: max(abs(sum of all unilateral pad axial forces - force_target)) over every executed integration step, including startup

coordinates.q: zA-zNut; independent screw extension, not zA-zB

mechanics.sea_spring_geometry_assumption: Captured opposed pair: 50 mm free each, 25 mm installed at zero net force, individual rate half the net rate, installed working length 8-42 mm. Approximate packing guard, not a purchased-part specification.

coil.continuous_current: not established by short diagnostic simulations; report RMS current and hot copper loss separately

screw_motor.reference: maxon RE35 273757, brushed DC reference; adequate static continuous torque, NRND example, not a purchase recommendation
screw_motor.shaft_friction_status: assumed smooth reversible transmission loss, not measured efficiency/backlash
screw_motor.temperature_assumption: 100 K winding rise, copper coefficient 0.0039/K; short runs do not qualify thermal performance

surface.ridge: full width across the pad; same original longitudinal profile in every comparison

pad.model: Vertical Kelvin-Voigt Winkler foundation; surrogate total axial-force model, no drag or local pressure scoring
pad.weights: Circular chord strip area weights with sum=1, holding total flat-contact k,c constant
pad.stiff_1MN_reference: Small-compliance contact surrogate, not the original imposed-contact native model; no foam working-compression claim
pad.stiffness_status: Representative whole-pad secant/tangent surrogate, plausibility bounded using published foam compression data; not measured sanding-pad dynamics

acquisition.screw_additional_measurement: independent nut/rotor encoder, inherent to motor position servo
acquisition.calibration: Known nominal mass and gravity tare initially; separate perturbation diagnostics, not a robust residual box
acquisition.old_fixed_cell_mode_feedback: disabled; dynamic S changes the cell mode, so its old fixed carrier is ineligible without retuning

controller_contract.coil: Force PI plus separately rolled-off measured-inertia feedforward and optional leaky integrated measured S velocity; force request converted to current
controller_contract.SEA: Force PI request to identified spring deflection; causal B-A estimate from S-A position and finite cell compliance; independently measured nut encoder; damped nut-position servo plus holding torque feedforward
controller_contract.tuning: Separate per identified actuator/pad configuration on designated development cases, then freeze before matched fresh-seed evaluation; retain all failed candidates
controller_contract.robot_in_main_short_study: Held fixed, zRobot=0, matched in both actuators; isolate fast actuator/pad comparison. These records do not qualify delayed recentering or long operation.
controller_contract.equilibrium_initialization: Loaded static equilibrium at requested force, gravity, pad compression, cell extension, upper deflection and motor current. Includes every noisy startup sample; not an acquisition/startup-at-zero-force qualification.

numerics.sample_event_alignment: Explicit scheduled ADC/controller/pipeline timestamps; do not silently pretend 30 kHz is integer multiple of base clock
numerics.native_check: Independent native Simulink physical-plant replay of recorded sampled controller commands and robot position; no claim this replay independently qualifies controller implementation

physical_stops: pad compression outside declared working range
failure_rules.partial_contact: allowed; do not stop for an individual unloaded strip
failure_rules.preparation_rejection: invalid loaded initial equilibrium or exceeded working compression; kept separately from executed outcomes

intended_evaluation.comment: 54 matched short records per selected configuration, actual executed coverage recorded by engine. No inference that this finite grid replaces frozen700-case normal-force qualification.
